item.title: The Range Rover Electric: Specs, Price, Availability
item.description: After long delays, JLR’s biggest gamble with its Range Rover brand is here with huge performance, range, and off-road EV skills. It’s mighty pricey, but the US gets a cheaper model.

item.title: On a pris le volant du Range Rover électrique : 550 ch cachés sous un look inchangé
item.description: Du côté du tout nouveau Range Rover, ne cherchez plus les pots d’échappement, ils ont disparu. Pour le reste, le roi des SUV de luxe britannique ne change pas son coup de crayon d'un iota. Mais sous cette robe inchangée se cache pourtant une révolution. Nous avons disséqué le Range Rover Électrique, qui s'offre une batterie monumentale et deux moteurs puissants totalement silencieux. Parce que oui, on l'a conduit aussi ! ...

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and says it’s up to 45 percent cheaper for agentic work

The company claims Claude Fable 5.1 offers stronger performance than Fable 5, but costs around 25 percent less typically and up to 45 percent less for complex agentic tasks, thanks to reduced pricing […]...

item.title: Apple Maps follows Google in renaming Lake Ontario
item.description: Apple Maps has officially changed the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America, as reported earlier by Bloomberg. The company joins Google in re-labeling the Great Lake following an executive order signed by President Donald Trump in the midst of a trade dispute with Canada. The Canadian version of Apple Maps still shows "Lake Ontario" […]
